note: Certificate authorities whose private keys are compromised. Every secure connection TradeAgent makes is refused when any certificate in its chain has one of these public keys (SHA-256 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, lower-case hex), even when the platform trusts the chain. A later change to this list is a data change. 'date' is the day Mozilla received the report of the compromise.
